description: Sign a 32-byte hex message with wallet key. [write] Requires checkin_token from terminal tx-checkin. → sign_transaction for raw tx signing.

chain.description: Chain: dex_chain_config name/alias (e.g. ETH, BSC, SOL), or pass EVM / SOL directly for the signing family. Unknown names are rejected via chain config; web3_business_wallet sign-message receives chain "EVM" or lowercase "sol" for Solana.

checkin_token.description: From successful tx-checkin response: the checkin_token string (terminal CLI stdout JSON). Must match the signing intent in the same flow.

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

name: dex_wallet_sign_message
